start.content: I heard him say it myself! "I will destroy this Temple and rebuild it in three days!" I was standing three cubits away. Both my colleague and I heard the same words.

choices.text: He spoke of the Temple of His body.
Why did your story change between hearings?

body_clarification.content: He spoke of stone and mortar! The Great Temple — the one behind us! A direct threat to the sacred institution. Caiaphas agrees with me. So does the second witness.

choices.text: Your second witness gave a different version.
Threatening the Temple carries a death sentence.

story_changed.content: The room is noisy! It is difficult to keep every word perfectly straight under pressure. But the substance is the same — He is a threat to the Law. The High Priest has affirmed that.

choices.text: The Law requires two witnesses with identical testimony.

law_requirement.content: The High Priest has the authority to proceed on the spirit of the charge! The letter of the procedure—

choices.text: The letter is the procedure. Without it you have no case.

death_implications.content: A man who threatens Rome's most valued institution in this city during Passover is a threat to everyone. The High Priest is protecting the people.

choices.text: By using testimony that does not align.

improvising.content: I am stating what I heard! The acoustics of the outer courts are difficult. Perhaps I paraphrased. But the meaning was clear — He is dangerous.

choices.text: Paraphrase is not testimony. Testimony is exact.
You were paid to be here.

payment_question.content: I— that is a serious accusation. My presence here is voluntary, as a civic-minded member of—

choices.text: Your presence was arranged through the Temple steward two days ago.

exposed.content: He is a blasphemer. That is all you need to record, Scribe. The High Priest knows the truth. Whatever procedural objections you raise, the council has already made its determination.

choices.text: A determination built on contradicted testimony.
The procedure is not an obstacle. It is the justice.

closing.content: Write what you like. The verdict will not change. Caiaphas has spoken. He is a blasphemer. That is sufficient.
